python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
print('items',len(items))
for start in range(0,len(items),5):
 rows=[]
 for j,it in enumerate(items[start:start+5],start+1):
  w=Image.open(it['word_image']).convert('RGB'); l=Image.open(it['line_image']).convert('RGB')
  row=Image.new('RGB',(max(1400,w.width+30,l.width+30),w.height+l.height+45),'white');d=ImageDraw.Draw(row);d.text((5,3),str(j)+' '+it['item_id'],fill='black');row.paste(w,(10,22));row.paste(l,(10,27+w.height));rows.append(row)
 sheet=Image.new('RGB',(max(r.width for r in rows),sum(r.height for r in rows)+20*len(rows)),'#dddddd');y=0
 for r in rows:sheet.paste(r,(0,y));y+=r.height+20
 sheet.save(f'zoom/b{start//5+1:02}.png')
PY
